description: Pins protocol::derive_subkey_v0_2 byte mapping for the membership KEK: the one role that derives under the v0.2 context prefix (info='myne.v0.2 '||role) because its field is NTV5-only. Vectors generated by `cargo test -p protocol --lib emit_subkey_v0_2_vectors_for_paste -- --ignored` (in protocol/src/subkey.rs).

cases.description: All-zero root_key with the MembershipKey role (§3.4; §9.3.1). KEK for the sealed vault membership field (the account/vault split, decisions.md 2026-09-07); role string 'membership-key' (14 ASCII bytes). Derived under the v0.2 context prefix because the field is NTV5-only: info is 'myne.v0.2 membership-key' (24 bytes). root_key-derived (like prefs/search/workspace), so it is itemsKey-independent. Pairs with the alpha vector under the same derivation: the two must differ only by root.

Pseudorandom alpha root with the MembershipKey role. The informational_info_utf8_hex field carries the canonical 24-byte HKDF info bytes ('myne.v0.2 membership-key') so independent implementers can verify this role's info assembly without re-parsing the spec. NOTE: the HKDF role string 'membership-key' is DISTINCT from the AAD role string 'membership-blob' (aad_membership_blob): two different load-bearing strings in the same feature.
